title: Establish spectral accessibility palette and fluid elevation steps for compact charts
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Small, high-density charts and dense table rows on dashboards are showing color and elevation collisions at compact sizes: low-contrast fills, saturated accents causing visual noise, and shadows that read as uneven depth at 24px components. This work updates the semantic color palette and elevation token system to support compact data surfaces while meeting WCAG contrast targets and consistent layering across themes.

Goals:
- Define a spectral (hue-consistent) accessibility-first palette with explicit semantic aliases for data/semantic uses (backgrounds, low/high emphasis, success/warn/error, chart axes, grid lines).
- Introduce fluid elevation tokens (elev-0..elev-4) that scale shadow blur, offset, and opacity for compact components and charts.
- Provide radius/spacing variants tuned for compact density (radius-compact, spacing-compact) and map them to existing tokens for gradual migration.
- Update typography scale guidance for small-chart micro-labels (caption-xs, caption-sm) and line-height rules to avoid clipping.
- Produce migration plan: token aliases, codemods, Storybook + visual diff tests, and rollout gating.

Design decisions and trade-offs:
- Prefer semantic token names (surface/interactive/outline/fg-muted) rather than raw ramp numbers to simplify migration for product teams.
- Use slightly desaturated accents for small chart marks to reduce perceived vibration while preserving categorical distinction.
- Elevation will use layered micro-shadow approach: combination of ambient blur + thin penumbra. This costs slightly more CSS variables but yields consistent depth at small scales.

Success metrics:
- All updated components meet 4.5:1 contrast for primary text and key chart marks in compact modes.
- Visual regression diffs under 2% noisy pixels for core dashboards after token swap.
- Migration adoption: >=50% of internal dashboards updated within 2 sprints of release with no regressions reported.
acceptance_criteria: New semantic palette published in token registry (Figma + code) with mapping table to legacy ramps
Fluid elevation tokens implemented in component library and visible in compact Storybook examples
Compact typography tokens (caption-xs, caption-sm) added and used in chart axis labels in two reference charts
Migration guide and codemod PR merged; at least one internal dashboard migrated and validated in canary
Automated visual diffs show no unexpected regressions and accessibility checks report >=4.5:1 for critical labels
